commission: Advance multiple independent non-P0 TRY FOREVER fronts without touching Phone Hands/P0 or duplicating provenance ownership.

fronts.name: portable provenance report paths
fronts.wound: The owner emits absolute repositoryRoot and generated-index paths into durable JSON. That leaks host-local path topology and makes equivalent reports differ across machines even though those strings are diagnostic rather than authority.
fronts.plannedAction: Add one pure path-projection policy plus hostile source fixtures. Repository-root projects to '.', in-repository evidence projects repo-relative, external evidence projects to a deterministic non-reversible digest marker. Never use display projection for filesystem access or authorization.

fronts.name: emission-time repository snapshot revalidation
fronts.wound: Current snapshot certification ends before generated-index inspection/report assembly. A later HEAD or cleanliness change can occur after certification but before the authority report is emitted.
fronts.plannedAction: Add one pure final-emission revalidation policy and regression source. It may reduce the late custody window but must explicitly refuse to claim atomic cross-platform repository binding.

fronts.name: durable skill harvest
fronts.plannedAction: Harvest only genuinely new repository skills for the two source contracts if no matching current-tree skill exists. Keep owner/test/runtime/deployment states explicit.

fronts.name: accessible Warm Wall
fronts.plannedAction: Mutate the existing provenance certification DOM/inline-SVG specimen in place so path privacy and final-emission custody are touch-inspectable with existing radio/focus/touch/reduced-motion semantics; no raster and no decorative motion.

fronts.name: Regnet and Venice review
fronts.plannedAction: Code-first bounded-source review. Any supporting policy remains supporting source until the existing owner consumes it. TESTED remains NO unless exact-head execution evidence proves otherwise.

fronts.name: execution evidence
fronts.plannedAction: Read fresh automatic workflow state only after source commits. Do not dispatch/retry unchanged failing CI and do not recycle an older failure cause.
